ROCKETSTAR / REUSABLE LAUNCH

To orbit.
Back for more.

A two-stage reusable rocket design for small satellites. Deliver the payload to low Earth orbit. Bring both stages home. Prepare the same vehicles to fly again.

Small satellitesBoth stages recoveredUncrewed

Design R1.0 · Flight and reuse not yet demonstrated.

A-LINK / SATELLITE COMMUNICATIONS

From orbit.
To avokado.

The rocket returns. A-LINK satellites are planned to stay in orbit, relaying messages and small data between ground gateways and compatible avokado receivers.

  1. Ground gateway
  2. A-LINK satellite
  3. avokado receiver

Reception needs coverage and a suitable antenna. Indoors may require an outdoor receiver. avocadoMini R5 integration is in development.

ROCKSTAROS / OPERATIONS FOUNDATION

One foundation.
Beyond Earth.

RockstarOS is designed to connect mission records, permissions, maintenance and communications — with a path toward future colony operations. Flight and critical equipment keep dedicated local controllers.
